The Phoenix Suns (1-2, 1-0 at home, 0-2 on the road) host the Denver Nuggets (1-2) in this Emirates NBA Cup West Group A game, the fourth of the 2026-27 season for Phoenix. The Suns are 11th in the West and 2nd in the Pacific, 2 games back, after a loss in their most recent game, while the Nuggets are 10th in the West and 4th in the Northwest, 2.5 games back, also on a one-game losing streak. The teams have not met yet this season, but Phoenix lost all three meetings with Denver in 2025-26, including a 125-123 loss in Phoenix on March 24, 2026.

Mark Williams is out for Phoenix with a shoulder injury following surgery, and Oso Ighodaro is day-to-day with an oblique strain and is a game-time decision. Denver is without Julian Strawther, who is out with a knee sprain.
